It is installed via npm install zod. Basic usage defines schemas (e.g., z.object({username: z.string(), xp: z.number()})) and validates with .parse() (or .parseAsync() for async refinements/transforms). On failure .parse() throws ZodError with granular issues including code, path and message, while .safeParse()/.safeParseAsync() avoid try/catch by returning a discriminated union of success/data or success/error.
